title: Pablo Exclusive Dark Cherry Nicotine Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Indulge in the deep, luxurious taste of Pablo Exclusive Dark Cherry Nicotine Pouches. This flavour captures the essence of ripe, juicy cherries, balancing dark fruit sweetness with a hint of tartness for a truly robust profile. With a 30mg/g nicotine strength, this is a pouch designed for the seasoned user seeking maximum satisfaction. The ultra-slim, tobacco-free design ensures a seamless fit under the lip, allowing you to enjoy the intense kick and bold flavour anywhere, anytime. A premium choice for those who appreciate strong nicotine and rich, complex fruit notes. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
